ModMetaData.name: Androids Don't Count
ModMetaData.author: ertzfiend
ModMetaData.description: Androids remain fully functional colonists, including on the colonist bar - they work, can be drafted, and appear alongside everyone else. But they do not inflate colony metrics: they are excluded from raid/threat point calculations and colony wealth (their market value, worn apparel, weapons, bionics, and inventory all count for nothing). Organic colonists are untouched.
